verdict.rationale: Airwallex is API-first and documents headless automation primitives: an official CLI, server-side SDKs with automatic retries and token refresh, scoped API keys for non-interactive credentials, and a separate sandbox suited to automated testing. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or non-interactive CLI documentation (e.g., env-var auth, headless flags, pipeline examples), stable non-beta SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
